issues: Generation ran one process at a time (main, then backups 1, 2 and 4 queued behind it); about 3.5 minutes an image. generate_sdxl.py needed no changes. The model ignores 'black background' most of the time and adds frames and fake text to nearly every technical sheet; long side-view fish come out stacked.
